```{r header_check, echo=TRUE, results='markup'}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# ==========================================================
# Check header consistency across CSVs
# - Print header for 1 sample (reference)
# - Detect mismatched columns in other samples
# ==========================================================

base_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/Variant_classification"

csv_files <- list.files(
  path = base_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(csv_files) == 0) stop("No CSV files found in directory.")

ref_file <- csv_files[1]
ref_header <- names(read.csv(ref_file, nrows = 1, check.names = FALSE))

cat("============================================\n")
cat("Reference Sample:", basename(ref_file), "\n")
cat("============================================\n")
print(ref_header)
cat("\nTotal columns:", length(ref_header), "\n\n")

mismatch_found <- FALSE

for (file in csv_files[-1]) {

  hdr <- names(read.csv(file, nrows = 1, check.names = FALSE))

  missing_cols <- setdiff(ref_header, hdr)
  extra_cols   <- setdiff(hdr, ref_header)

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0 || length(extra_cols) > 0) {

    mismatch_found <- TRUE

    cat("============================================\n")
    cat("Mismatch in:", basename(file), "\n")
    cat("============================================\n")

    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      cat("Missing columns:\n")
      print(missing_cols)
    }

    if (length(extra_cols) > 0) {
      cat("Extra columns:\n")
      print(extra_cols)
    }

    cat("\n")
  }
}

if (!mismatch_found) {
  cat("All files have identical columns.\n")
}

top_n <- function(x, n = 12) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  tab <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  tab[seq_len(min(n, length(tab)))]
}

cat("\n[Counts]\n")
```

```{r setup}
# Variant classification (Only coding variants)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tools)
  library(grid)   # for gpar()
})

BASE_DIR  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/Variant_classification"
META_FILE <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/WGS_TMB_Grade.csv"

# ==========================================================
# Helper functions
# ==========================================================

collapse_consequence <- function(consequence) {
  if (is.na(consequence) || consequence == "") return("Other")

  x <- tolower(trimws(consequence))
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  terms <- unlist(strsplit(x, ","))

  has <- function(pat) any(grepl(pat, terms, fixed = TRUE))

  if (has("splice_acceptor_variant") || has("splice_donor_variant"))
    return("Splice_Site")

  if (has("stop_gained") || has("stop_lost"))
    return("Nonsense_Mutation")

  if (has("frameshift_variant"))
    return("Frame_Shift")

  if (has("inframe_insertion"))
    return("In_Frame_Ins")

  if (has("inframe_deletion"))
    return("In_Frame_Del")

  if (has("missense_variant") || has("protein_altering_variant"))
    return("Missense_Mutation")

  return("Other")
}

collapse_onco <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x)
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") return(NA_character_)
  if (x %in% c("Oncogenic", "Likely_Oncogenic")) return("Oncogenic")
  if (x == "VUS") return("VUS")
  if (x == "Likely_Benign") return("Likely_Benign")
  return(NA_character_)
}
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# Load all samples
# ==========================================================

csv_files <- sort(list.files(BASE_DIR, pattern="\\.csv$", full.names=TRUE))
if (length(csv_files) == 0) stop("No CSV files found in: ", BASE_DIR)

sample_names <- file_path_sans_ext(basename(csv_files))

gene_list <- list()
full_data <- list()

for (i in seq_along(csv_files)) {
  df <- read.csv(csv_files[i], check.names = FALSE)

  # --- Normalize SYMBOL to avoid whitespace mismatch ---
  df$SYMBOL <- trimws(df$SYMBOL)
  df$SYMBOL[df$SYMBOL == ""] <- NA
  df <- df[!is.na(df$SYMBOL), ]

  df$Sample <- sample_names[i]
  full_data[[sample_names[i]]] <- df
  gene_list[[sample_names[i]]] <- unique(df$SYMBOL)
}
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# Identify shared genes (>=3 samples)
# ==========================================================

gene_freq <- table(unlist(gene_list))
shared_genes <- names(gene_freq[gene_freq >= 3])
shared_genes <- trimws(shared_genes)

cat("Shared genes (>=3 samples):", length(shared_genes), "\n")
cat("Shared genes:\n")
print(shared_genes)
```
```{r}
# ==========================================================
# Build mutation matrix
# ==========================================================

# Use NA for "no mutation call" cells (cleaner than "")
mat <- matrix(NA_character_,
              nrow = length(shared_genes),
              ncol = length(sample_names),
              dimnames = list(shared_genes, sample_names))

for (s in sample_names) {

  df <- full_data[[s]]
  df$SYMBOL <- trimws(df$SYMBOL)
  df <- df[df$SYMBOL %in% shared_genes, ]

  if (nrow(df) == 0) next

  for (g in unique(df$SYMBOL)) {

    sub <- df[df$SYMBOL == g, ]

    # If multiple variants in same gene/sample -> Multi_Hit (black)
    if (nrow(sub) > 1) {
      mat[g, s] <- "Multi_Hit"
    } else {
      mat[g, s] <- collapse_consequence(sub$CONSEQUENCE[1])
    }
  }
}  # close sample loop

# Quick sanity checks (optional, keep during development)
cat("\nFilled cells per sample:\n")
print(colSums(!is.na(mat)))

cat("\nVariant classes present:\n")
print(sort(table(na.omit(as.vector(mat))), decreasing = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# ORDER GENES BY FREQUENCY (highest -> lowest)
# ==========================================================
pct_altered <- rowMeans(!is.na(mat)) * 100
ord <- order(pct_altered, decreasing = TRUE)

mat <- mat[ord, , drop = FALSE]
pct_altered <- pct_altered[ord]
pct_labels  <- paste0(round(pct_altered), "%")

# Right-side labels (text, not barplot)
right_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  "Altered" = anno_text(pct_labels, just = "left", gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)),
  annotation_name_side = "top",
  width = unit(12, "mm")
)

# ==========================================================
# STAR matrix
# ==========================================================
star_mat <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat),
                   dimnames = dimnames(mat))

for (s in sample_names) {
  df <- full_data[[s]]
  df$SYMBOL <- trimws(df$SYMBOL)
  df <- df[df$SYMBOL %in% rownames(mat), ]

  if (nrow(df) == 0) next

  for (g in unique(df$SYMBOL)) {
    sub <- df[df$SYMBOL == g, ]
    if (any(sub$ONCOGENICITY %in% c("Oncogenic", "Likely_Oncogenic"), na.rm = TRUE)) {
      star_mat[g, s] <- "*"
    }
  }
}

cat("Total oncogenic stars:", sum(star_mat == "*"), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# Load TMB and Grade metadata
# ==========================================================

meta <- read.csv(META_FILE, check.names = FALSE)
meta$Sample <- trimws(meta$Sample)
rownames(meta) <- meta$Sample

# keep only relevant samples, in the same order as heatmap columns
meta <- meta[sample_names, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# Define colors
# ==========================================================

variant_colors <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation" = "#1f78b4",
  "Nonsense_Mutation" = "#e31a1c",
  "Frame_Shift"       = "#ff7f00",
  "Splice_Site"       = "#6a3d9a",
  "In_Frame_Ins"      = "#33a02c",
  "In_Frame_Del"      = "#b2df8a",
  "Other"             = "grey70",
  "Multi_Hit"         = "#666666"
)

grade_colors <- c(
  "II"  = "#fc8d62",
  "III" = "#8da0cb"
)

```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# Top Annotation
# ==========================================================

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  TMB = anno_barplot(meta$TMB, border = FALSE, gp = gpar(fill = "grey40")),
  Grade = factor(meta$Grade,
                 levels = c(2, 3),
                 labels = c("II", "III")),
  col = list(
    Grade = grade_colors
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

```

```{r}
# ==========================================================
# 8. Draw Heatmap
# ==========================================================

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Variant",
  col = variant_colors,
  na_col = "grey90",
  top_annotation = top_anno,
  right_annotation = right_anno,
  row_names_side = "left",
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white"),

  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (!is.na(star_mat[i, j]) && star_mat[i, j] == "*") {
      grid.text("*", x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))
    }
  }
)

star_lgd <- Legend(
  labels = "Oncogenic",
  type = "points",
  pch = "*",
  legend_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
  title = "Oncogenicity"
)


draw(ht, annotation_legend_list = list(star_lgd))
```


```{r}
# ---- Save as PDF ----
pdf("pILC_shared_genes_heatmap.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
draw(ht, annotation_legend_list = list(star_lgd), newpage = TRUE)
dev.off()

# ---- Save as PNG ----
png("pILC_shared_genes_heatmap.png", width = 3000, height = 2400, res = 300)
draw(ht, annotation_legend_list = list(star_lgd), newpage = TRUE)
```
